answer: Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, weighted by independent path length, idle agents bleed standing. What survives to the pigment is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. The terrace holds work receipts rather than names, so the horizon of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread.
